uncited: The algorithm operates on the octree hierarchy.
Each node in the octree represents a cell.
The traversal logic assumes standard octree subdivision where a parent cell has 8 sub-cells.
*   **Minimal Edge:** An edge that does not contain any other edge in a neighboring octree cell.
The connectivity generation is performed by three mutually recursive functions: `CellProc`, `FaceProc`, and `EdgeProc`.
*   Recursively call `CellProc` for every sub-cell of $c$.
*   Make 12 calls to `FaceProc` for every pair of face-adjacent sub-cells of $c$.
*   Make 6 calls to `EdgeProc` for all four sub-cells sharing an edge of $c$.
**FaceProc(c1, c2):** Receives two cells $c1$ and $c2$ sharing a common face $f$.
*   Recursively call `FaceProc` four times, once for every pair of sub-cells of $c1$ and $c2$ that share a face contained in $f$.
*   Make 4 calls to `EdgeProc` for every four sub-cells (two from $c1$, two from $c2$) that share an edge contained in $f$.
**EdgeProc(c1, c2, c3, c4):** Receives four edge-adjacent cells sharing a common edge.
*   In the uniform case, the four cells are distinct.
*   Make 2 recursive calls to `EdgeProc` for all four sub-cells sharing a half-edge contained in the current edge.
*   **Patch Generation:** When `EdgeProc` receives four cells that share a **minimal edge** (i.e., no further subdivision exists along that edge in the neighborhood), it generates a surface patch.
*   **Adaptive Case:** In adaptive octrees, one of the four cells sharing an edge may be repeated (only three distinct cells).
*   **Minimal Edge Definition:** A minimal edge is defined as one that does not contain any other edge in a neighboring octree cell.
*   **Time Complexity:** The algorithm performs a recursive traversal of the octree.
The complexity is proportional to the number of nodes in the octree, specifically focusing on the boundary between occupied and empty cells.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storage for the octree structure and the dual nodes.
The connectivity generation itself is local and does not require global data structures.
The method is used to extract the connectivity of the surface before dual nodes are localized and connected.
